Email._comment: ZedAdmin = the Database Mail profile ZedAdmin of the old instance (account QCI_ZED_Notifications), which all 25 converted procedures use. Password from user secrets / environment (Email__Profiles__ZedAdmin__Password). Without this profile the mail goes out through Default.

Jobs._comment: Schedules: the production SQL Agent jobs (export of 2026-10-21, docs/JOBS.md), all off. At cut-over set Enabled on the server copy for each job whose Agent job is switched off at the same time; run Zed.Jobs --check first. Times are in TimeZone; the old instance runs in IST, like TimeZone (docs/JOBS.md).

Schedules.Name: AutoMail_Recertification
Schedules.Note: Agent export 2026-10-21: SQL Agent job 'AutoMail_Recertification', enabled on production (Runs night time to send certification recertification emails and enable recertification button.). Set Enabled at cut-over when that Agent job is switched off.

Schedules.Name: AutoReject
Schedules.Note: Agent export 2026-10-21: SQL Agent job 'AutoReject', enabled on production. Set Enabled at cut-over when that Agent job is switched off.

Schedules.Name: AutoSuspendingSilverGold
Schedules.Note: Agent export 2026-10-21: SQL Agent job 'AutoSuspendingSilverGold', enabled on production (This is the Job to suspend the silver and gold 15 months completed zedids who are not applied for surveillance). Set Enabled at cut-over when that Agent job is switched off.

Schedules.Name: Bronze_Surveillance_Job
Schedules.Note: Agent export 2026-10-21: SQL Agent job 'Bronze_Surveillance_Job', enabled on production (This job runs stored procedures for inserting surveillance data of BRONZE and sending auto emails.). Set Enabled at cut-over when that Agent job is switched off.

Schedules.Name: Certificate_Expiry
Schedules.Note: Agent export 2026-10-21: SQL Agent job 'Certificate_Expiry', enabled on production (This job update the flag as expired when the certification date is completed 3 years). Set Enabled at cut-over when that Agent job is switched off.

Schedules.Name: Silver_Gold_Surveillance_Data_job

Schedules.Note: Agent export 2026-10-21: SQL Agent job 'ZED_Daily_Maintenance_Job', enabled on production (Runs Surveillance Cleanup and Dashboard Refresh twice daily.). Set Enabled at cut-over when that Agent job is switched off.
